title: Teaming with Eddie Lockjaw Davis; Lady Sings the Blues
summary: Edison tells how the Davis partnership began in 1977 after he did the trumpet work for Lady Sings the Blues and the Julie Andrews show.

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Jazz musicians on film and studio scoring

blocks.x: Now we've got, for the last half hour, we've come nearly up to date. When did you start the thing with Lockjaw?

We had been recording together in New York off and on. Riverside, we did an album, and we had known each other a long time. So we started corresponding about getting together, you know, and he was busy and I was busy, too, but I was doing good, you know, making records, and I had this -- I did 26 weeks with Julie Andrews, her show, and I was really busy doing a lot of things and I got this assignment to do all the trumpet work in "Lady Sings the Blues."
Did all the work for that.
